# 🪪 Model Card Template

## System/version
Name, component, commit and owner.

## Intended and prohibited use
State scope and prohibited high-impact uses where appropriate.

## Method
Formal algorithm, assumptions, inputs, outputs and dependencies.

## Data
Provenance, features, target, splits and limitations.

## Evaluation
Metrics and protocol. Never report training score as test performance.

## Limitations, risks and maintenance
Weaknesses, misuse, re-evaluation triggers, owner and retirement process.
